texts: We measured our Audio2Face-3D rig mapping on 468 real user avatars for a GTC 2027 poster submission: 98.1% of rigs with any face morphs are driven from one blendshape track, with no per-rig code, and text to synchronized speech and animation takes a median 3.8 s. Poster, data and build scripts: github.com/nirholas/three.ws/tree/main/docs/nvidia-gtc-2027

The derived path runs the viseme-to-ARKit tables backwards, so a VRM or Oculus rig gets a usable mouth from the same track. It stays off any mesh that already has a direct jaw or mouth shape: with that rule off, the mouth saturates in 23% of voiced frames.
